description:
After T9, `Filament.Observable` reduces to the public callback behaviour (`handle_subscribe/2`, `handle_unsubscribe/2`) that `Filament.Observable.GenServer`'s Cell transport invokes. Verify nothing else is left in the namespace and the moduledoc reflects the new reality.

Update guides:
- `guides/cells.md` (if present) — describe `use_observable` (post-rename) as the only hook, with `Filament.Cell` as the underlying behaviour.
- Remove or update any guide that still mentions `%Subscriber{}`, `session_token`, `via_registry` as observable-layer concerns.

Final gates:
- `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`
- `mix test` (all tests)
- `mix credo --strict`
- `mix dialyzer`
- All four example apps verified in Chrome end-to-end.

Add a CHANGELOG entry under `## [Unreleased]` capturing the breaking change: `use_observable` semantics now go through `Filament.Cell`; `Filament.Observable.Subscriber` is removed.
title: Collapse Observable module and finalize gates
